title: Add PAYG BYOK gateway and model router invariant verifiers in susi-harness
goal: Add GatewayState::verify_state_invariants in crates/susi-harness/src/gateway.rs and UpstreamRoute::verify_route_invariants in crates/susi-harness/src/router.rs with comprehensive unit tests.
acceptance: GatewayState::verify_state_invariants validates ledger_path, provider, upstream_chat_url, timeout_secs, api_key, and max_output_tokens; UpstreamRoute::verify_route_invariants validates URL scheme, model_id, JSON content-type, and Anthropic vs OpenAI authentication headers.
